references.text: The fundamental principle of the same chapter is that everything a man with a discharge lies on or sits on becomes unclean. This establishes the broader principle that verse 9 applies to riding animals.
A parallel provision regarding uncleanness from sitting where the one with a discharge has sat, which is extended in verse 9 to include saddles and riding gear.
The general principle of transferring uncleanness to objects, forming the basis for understanding how riding equipment becomes unclean.
A corresponding provision for women with a discharge, where the same principle of uncleanness through contact with a bed or object applies.
An extension of purity laws dealing with uncleanness through touch, showing how impurity spreads through contact with unclean objects.
The prophet Haggai uses a similar principle of transferring uncleanness to illustrate spiritual truths about the people's condition.
